 * CLM VIEW MY REQUESTS — Client Script
 */

api.controller = function($scope) {
    var c = this;

    // ── Init ────
    c.data.filteredRequests = [];
    c.data.selectedRequest  = null;
    c.data.filterSegment    = '';
    c.data.filterType       = '';
    c.data.filterStatus     = '';
    c.data.refreshing       = false;
    c.data.lastRefreshed    = '';

    // ── Build filtered list ───────
    c.applyFilters = function() {
        var seg  = c.data.filterSegment   || '';
        var typ  = c.data.filterType      || '';
        var stat = c.data.filterStatus    || '';

        c.data.filteredRequests = (c.data.requests || []).filter(function(req) {
            if (seg  && req.segment       !== seg)  return false;
            if (typ  && req.customer_type !== typ)  return false;
            if (stat && req.state         !== stat) return false;
            return true;
        });
    };

    // Watch filters
    $scope.$watch(function() { return c.data.filterSegment; }, function() { c.applyFilters(); });
    $scope.$watch(function() { return c.data.filterType;    }, function() { c.applyFilters(); });
    $scope.$watch(function() { return c.data.filterStatus;  }, function() { c.applyFilters(); });

    // ── Load requests on init ─────────────────────────
    if (c.data.requests && c.data.requests.length > 0) {
        c.applyFilters();
        c.data.lastRefreshed = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
    } else {
        c.refreshRequests();
    }

    // ── Refresh ────────────────────────────────────────
    c.refreshRequests = function() {
        c.data.refreshing = true;
        c.server.get({ action: 'refresh' })
        .then(function(r) {
            c.data.refreshing    = false;
            c.data.lastRefreshed = new Date().toLocaleTimeString();
            if (r.data.requests) {
                c.data.requests = r.data.requests;
            } else {
                c.data.requests = [];
            }
            c.applyFilters();
        }).catch(function() {
            c.data.refreshing = false;
            c.data.requests   = c.data.requests || [];
            c.applyFilters();
        });
    };
// Add search functionality
c.data.searchTerm = '';

c.applySearch = function() {
    if (!c.data.searchTerm || c.data.searchTerm.trim() === '') {
        c.data.filteredRequests = c.data.requests.filter(req => {
            var seg = c.data.filterSegment || '';
            var typ = c.data.filterType || '';
            var stat = c.data.filterStatus || '';
            
            if (seg && req.segment !== seg) return false;
            if (typ && req.customer_type !== typ) return false;
            if (stat && req.state !== stat) return false;
            return true;
        });
        return;
    }
    
    var searchTerm = c.data.searchTerm.toLowerCase().trim();
    c.data.filteredRequests = c.data.requests.filter(function(req) {
        var seg = c.data.filterSegment || '';
        var typ = c.data.filterType || '';
        var stat = c.data.filterStatus || '';
        
        // Skip if filters don't match
        if (seg && req.segment !== seg) return false;
        if (typ && req.customer_type !== typ) return false;
        if (stat && req.state !== stat) return false;
        
        // Check if search term matches customer name or request number
        return (req.customer_name && req.customer_name.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm)) ||
               (req.number && req.number.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm));
    });
};

// Update filter functions to also apply search
function updateFilters() {
    c.applyFilters();
    c.applySearch();
}

$scope.$watch(function() { return c.data.filterSegment; }, updateFilters);
$scope.$watch(function() { return c.data.filterType; }, updateFilters);
$scope.$watch(function() { return c.data.filterStatus; }, updateFilters);
    // ── Open detail ────────────────────────────────────

  CLM VIEW MY REQUESTS — Widget HTML
  Shows all requests submitted by the logged-in user
-->

<div class="clm-my-requests">

  <!-- ── HEADER ── -->
  <div class="clm-mr-header">
    <div>
      <div class="clm-mr-title">My Requests</div>
      <div class="clm-mr-subtitle">Track all your submitted credit limit requests</div>
    </div>
    <div style="display:flex; align-items:center; gap:12px;">
      <button class="clm-refresh-btn"
              ng-click="c.refreshRequests()"
              ng-disabled="c.data.refreshing">
        <span ng-if="!c.data.refreshing">↻ Refresh</span>
        <span ng-if="c.data.refreshing">↻ Refreshing...</span>
      </button>
      <div class="clm-mr-count-badge" ng-if="c.data.requests && c.data.requests.length > 0">
        {{c.data.requests.length}} total
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <!-- Add this after the header title -->
<div class="clm-mr-search-container" style="margin: 12px 20px 0;">
  <input type="text" 
         class="clm-mr-search-input" 
         placeholder="Search by customer name or request number (e.g., CLM1023)"
         ng-model="c.data.searchTerm"
         ng-change="c.applySearch()"
         style="width: 100%; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 4px; font-size: 14px;">
</div>

  <!-- ── LAST REFRESHED ── -->
  <div class="clm-mr-refreshed" ng-if="c.data.lastRefreshed">
    Last refreshed: {{c.data.lastRefreshed}}
  </div>

  <!-- ── EMPTY STATE ── -->
  <div class="clm-mr-empty"
       ng-if="!c.data.selectedRequest && (!c.data.requests || c.data.requests.length === 0)">
    <div class="clm-mr-empty-icon">]]>📋<![CDATA[</div>
    <div class="clm-mr-empty-title">No requests yet</div>
    <div class="clm-mr-empty-sub">You haven't submitted any credit limit requests.</div>
    <button class="clm-btn clm-btn-outline" style="margin-top:16px"
            ng-click="c.createNewRequest()">+ Create New Request</button>
  </div>

  <!-- ── REQUEST LIST ── -->
  <div class="clm-mr-list"
       ng-if="!c.data.selectedRequest && c.data.requests && c.data.requests.length > 0">

    <!-- Filter bar -->
    <div class="clm-mr-filters">
      <div class="clm-mr-filter-item">
        <label>FILTER BY SEGMENT</label>
        <select ng-model="c.data.filterSegment" class="clm-mr-select">
          <option value="">All Segments</option>
          <option value="Cement">Cement</option>
          <option value="RMC">RMC</option>
          <option value="BPD">BPD</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-mr-filter-item">
        <label>FILTER BY TYPE</label>
        <select ng-model="c.data.filterType" class="clm-mr-select">
          <option value="">All Types</option>
          <option value="Trade">Trade</option>
          <option value="Non-Trade">Non-Trade</option>
          <option value="Key">Key</option>
        </select>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-mr-filter-item">
        <label>FILTER BY STATUS</label>
        <select ng-model="c.data.filterStatus" class="clm-mr-select">
          <option value="">All Statuses</option>
          <option value="Submitted">Submitted</option>
          <option value="Approved">Approved</option>
          <option value="Rejected">Rejected</option>
          <option value="Returned">Returned</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Request cards -->
    <div class="clm-mr-card"
         ng-repeat="req in c.data.filteredRequests"
         ng-click="c.openRequest(req)">

      <div class="clm-mr-card-top">
        <div class="clm-mr-card-left">
          <div class="clm-mr-card-num">
            {{req.number}}
            <span class="clm-type-pill clm-pill-trade"    ng-if="req.customer_type == 'Trade'">Trade</span>
            <span class="clm-type-pill clm-pill-nontrade" ng-if="req.customer_type == 'Non-Trade'">Non-Trade</span>
            <span class="clm-type-pill clm-pill-key"      ng-if="req.customer_type == 'Key'">Key</span>
          </div>
          <div class="clm-mr-card-name">{{req.customer_name}}</div>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-mr-card-right">
          <span class="clm-badge clm-badge-segment">{{req.segment}}</span>
          <span class="clm-badge clm-badge-status clm-status-submitted" ng-if="req.state == 'Submitted'">SUBMITTED</span>
          <span class="clm-badge clm-badge-status clm-status-approved" ng-if="req.state == 'Approved'">APPROVED</span>
          <span class="clm-badge clm-badge-status clm-status-rejected" ng-if="req.state == 'Rejected'">REJECTED</span>
          <span class="clm-badge clm-badge-status clm-status-returned" ng-if="req.state == 'Returned'">RETURNED</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <!-- Trade metrics -->
      <div class="clm-mr-card-metrics" ng-if="req.customer_type == 'Trade'">
        <div class="clm-mr-metric">
          <span class="clm-mr-metric-label">Requested</span>
          <span class="clm-mr-metric-value">₹{{req.requested_limit | number:2}}L</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-mr-metric">
          <span class="clm-mr-metric-label">Approved</span>
          <span class="clm-mr-metric-value">₹{{req.approved_limit | number:2}}L</span>
        </div>
       
      </div>

      <!-- Non-Trade / Key metrics -->
      <div class="clm-mr-card-metrics" ng-if="req.customer_type != 'Trade'">
        <div class="clm-mr-metric">
          <span class="clm-mr-metric-label">Requested</span>
          <span class="clm-mr-metric-value">₹{{req.requested_limit | number:1}}L</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-mr-metric">
          <span class="clm-mr-metric-label">Approved</span>
          <span class="clm-mr-metric-value">₹{{req.approved_limit | number:1}}L</span>
        </div>
        <div class="clm-mr-metric">
          <span class="clm-mr-metric-label">Aging</span>
          <span class="clm-mr-metric-value clm-val-ok"     ng-if="req.aging_rating == 'a'">{{req.aging_rating}}</span>
          <span class="clm-mr-metric-value clm-val-warn"   ng-if="req.aging_rating == 'b'">{{req.aging_rating}}</span>
          <span class="clm-mr-metric-value clm-val-danger" ng-if="req.aging_rating == 'c'">{{req.aging_rating}}</span>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="clm-mr-card-footer">
        <span class="clm-mr-footer-item">Submitted: {{req.created}}</span>
        <span class="clm-mr-footer-item" ng-if="req.decided">Decided: {{req.decided}}</span>
        <span class="clm-mr-footer-cta">View Details →</span>
      </div>
    </div>

    <div class="clm-mr-no-filter" ng-if="c.data.filteredRequests && c.data.filteredRequests.length === 0">
      No requests match the selected filters.
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- ── DETAIL VIEW ── -->
  <div class="clm-mr-detail" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest">

    <div class="clm-mr-detail-header">
      <!-- APPROVAL TRACKER -->

      <button class="clm-back-btn" ng-click="c.closeRequest()">← Back</button>
      <div class="clm-mr-detail-title">
        <!-- APPROVAL TRACKER -->
<div class="approval-tracker"
     ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.approval_steps">

  <div class="step"
       ng-repeat="step in c.data.selectedRequest.approval_steps track by $index">

  <div class="circle"
     ng-class="{
       'done': step.state == 'approved',
       'pending': step.state == 'requested',
       'rejected': step.state == 'rejected'
     }">
      <span ng-if="step.state=='approved'">✔</span>
      <span ng-if="step.state=='pending'">●</span>
      <span ng-if="step.state=='rejected'">✖</span>
    </div>

    <div class="label">{{step.name}}</div>

    <div class="line" ng-if="!$last"></div>
  </div>

</div>
        
      {{c.data.selectedRequest.number}} — {{c.data.selectedRequest.customer_name}}
   
       
        <span class="clm-badge clm-badge-segment">{{c.data.selectedRequest.segment}}</span>
        <span class="clm-type-pill clm-pill-trade"    ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.customer_type == 'Trade'">Trade</span>
        <span class="clm-type-pill clm-pill-nontrade" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.customer_type == 'Non-Trade'">Non-Trade</span>
        <span class="clm-type-pill clm-pill-key"      ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.customer_type == 'Key'">Key</span>
        <span class="clm-badge clm-badge-status clm-status-submitted" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.state == 'Submitted'">SUBMITTED</span>
        <span class="clm-badge clm-badge-status clm-status-approved" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.state == 'Approved'">APPROVED</span>
        <span class="clm-badge clm-badge-status clm-status-rejected" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.state == 'Rejected'">REJECTED</span>
        <span class="clm-badge clm-badge-status clm-status-returned" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.state == 'Returned'">RETURNED</span>
      </div>
      
      
     
      
      
    </div>

    <!-- Summary row TRADE -->
    <div class="clm-mr-summary-row" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.customer_type == 'Trade'">
      <div class="clm-mr-summary-card">
        <div class="clm-summary-label">Requested</div>
        <div class="clm-summary-value">₹{{c.data.selectedRequest.requested_limit | number:2}}L</div>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-mr-summary-card">
        <div class="clm-summary-label">Approved</div>
        <div class="clm-summary-value">₹{{c.data.selectedRequest.approved_limit | number:2}}L</div>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-mr-summary-card">
        <div class="clm-summary-label">Net Exposure</div>
        <div class="clm-summary-value">₹{{c.data.selectedRequest.net_exposure | number:2}}L</div>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-mr-summary-card">
        <div class="clm-summary-label">Max Allowable</div>
        <div class="clm-summary-value">₹{{c.data.selectedRequest.max_allowable | number:2}}L</div>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-mr-summary-card">
        <div class="clm-summary-label">Multiplier</div>
        <div class="clm-summary-value">{{c.data.selectedRequest.implied_mult | number:2}}x</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Summary row NON-TRADE/KEY -->
    <div class="clm-mr-summary-row" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.customer_type != 'Trade'">
      <div class="clm-mr-summary-card">
        <div class="clm-summary-label">Requested</div>
        <div class="clm-summary-value">₹{{c.data.selectedRequest.requested_limit | number:1}}L</div>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-mr-summary-card">
        <div class="clm-summary-label">Approved</div>
        <div class="clm-summary-value">₹{{c.data.selectedRequest.approved_limit | number:1}}L</div>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-mr-summary-card">
        <div class="clm-summary-label">P1 — MACL</div>
        <div class="clm-summary-value">₹{{c.data.selectedRequest.p1_macl | number:1}}L</div>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-mr-summary-card">
        <div class="clm-summary-label">P2 — Composite</div>
        <div class="clm-summary-value">{{(c.data.selectedRequest.p2_composite * 100) | number:1}}%</div>
      </div>
      <div class="clm-mr-summary-card">
        <div class="clm-summary-label">P3 — Credit</div>
        <div class="clm-summary-value">{{(c.data.selectedRequest.p3_credit * 100) | number:0}}%</div>
      </div>
    </div>

    <!-- Body -->
    <div class="clm-mr-detail-body">
      <div class="clm-mr-detail-left">
        <div class="clm-mr-detail-section">
          <div class="clm-mr-detail-section-title">Request Information</div>
          <div class="clm-mr-kv-row"><span class="clm-mr-kv-key">Request Number</span><span class="clm-mr-kv-val">{{c.data.selectedRequest.number}}</span></div>
          <div class="clm-mr-kv-row"><span class="clm-mr-kv-key">Customer Code</span><span class="clm-mr-kv-val">{{c.data.selectedRequest.customer_code}}</span></div>
          <div class="clm-mr-kv-row"><span class="clm-mr-kv-key">Type</span><span class="clm-mr-kv-val">{{c.data.selectedRequest.customer_type}}</span></div>
          <div class="clm-mr-kv-row"><span class="clm-mr-kv-key">Segment</span><span class="clm-mr-kv-val">{{c.data.selectedRequest.segment}}</span></div>
          <div class="clm-mr-kv-row"><span class="clm-mr-kv-key">Status</span><span class="clm-mr-kv-val">{{c.data.selectedRequest.state}}</span></div>
          <div class="clm-mr-kv-row"><span class="clm-mr-kv-key">Submitted On</span><span class="clm-mr-kv-val">{{c.data.selectedRequest.created}}</span></div>
          <div class="clm-mr-kv-row" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.decided"><span class="clm-mr-kv-key">Decided On</span><span class="clm-mr-kv-val">{{c.data.selectedRequest.decided}}</span></div>
          <div class="clm-mr-kv-row" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.approver_name"><span class="clm-mr-kv-val">Decided By</span><span class="clm-mr-kv-val">{{c.data.selectedRequest.approver_name}}</span></div>
        </div>

        <div class="clm-mr-detail-section" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.aging_detail">
          <div class="clm-mr-detail-section-title">6-Month Aging Breakdown</div>
          <div class="clm-aging-row">
            <span class="clm-aging-label">0–60 Days (Safe)</span>
            <div class="clm-aging-bar-bg"><div class="clm-aging-bar clm-aging-safe" ng-style="{width: c.data.selectedRequest.aging_detail.safe_pct + '%'}"></div></div>
            <span class="clm-aging-pct">{{c.data.selectedRequest.aging_detail.safe_pct}}%</span>
          </div>
          <div class="clm-aging-row">
            <span class="clm-aging-label">61–75 Days</span>
            <div class="clm-aging-bar-bg"><div class="clm-aging-bar clm-aging-warn" ng-style="{width: c.data.selectedRequest.aging_detail.warn_pct + '%'}"></div></div>
            <span class="clm-aging-pct">{{c.data.selectedRequest.aging_detail.warn_pct}}%</span>
          </div>
          <div class="clm-aging-row">
            <span class="clm-aging-label">76–90 Days</span>
            <div class="clm-aging-bar-bg"><div class="clm-aging-bar clm-aging-crit" ng-style="{width: c.data.selectedRequest.aging_detail.crit_pct + '%'}"></div></div>
            <span class="clm-aging-pct">{{c.data.selectedRequest.aging_detail.crit_pct}}%</span>
          </div>
          <div class="clm-aging-row">
            <span class="clm-aging-label">>90 Days (Toxic)</span>
            <div class="clm-aging-bar-bg"><div class="clm-aging-bar clm-aging-toxic" ng-style="{width: c.data.selectedRequest.aging_detail.toxic_pct + '%'}"></div></div>
            <span class="clm-aging-pct">{{c.data.selectedRequest.aging_detail.toxic_pct}}%</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="clm-mr-detail-right">
        <div class="clm-mr-detail-section">
          <div class="clm-mr-detail-section-title">Business Justification</div>
          <div class="clm-mr-justification-text">{{c.data.selectedRequest.justification || 'Not provided'}}</div>
        </div>

        <div class="clm-mr-detail-section" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.is_deviation">
          <div class="clm-mr-detail-section-title" style="color:#c0392b">⚠ Deviation Justification</div>
          <div class="clm-mr-justification-text clm-justification-dev">{{c.data.selectedRequest.deviation_justification || 'Not provided'}}</div>
        </div>

        <div class="clm-mr-detail-section" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.state == 'Returned'">
          <div class="clm-mr-detail-section-title" style="color:#f39c12">↩ Return Comments</div>
          <div class="clm-mr-justification-text clm-justification-return">{{c.data.selectedRequest.return_comments || 'No comments'}}</div>
        </div>

        <div class="clm-mr-detail-section" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.state == 'Rejected'">
          <div class="clm-mr-detail-section-title" style="color:#e74c3c">✕ Rejection Reason</div>
          <div class="clm-mr-justification-text clm-justification-reject">{{c.data.selectedRequest.rejection_reason || 'No reason provided'}}</div>
        </div>

        <div class="clm-mr-detail-section" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.state == 'Approved'">
          <div class="clm-mr-detail-section-title" style="color:#27ae60">✓ Approval Details</div>
          <div class="clm-mr-kv-row"><span class="clm-mr-kv-key">Approved Limit</span><span class="clm-mr-kv-val">₹{{c.data.selectedRequest.approved_limit | number:2}}L</span></div>
          <div class="clm-mr-kv-row" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.next_review_date"><span class="clm-mr-kv-key">Next Review Date</span><span class="clm-mr-kv-val">{{c.data.selectedRequest.next_review_date}}</span></div>
        </div>
         

        <!-- Action buttons based on status -->
        <div class="clm-mr-detail-section clm-mr-action-section" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.state == 'Returned'">
          <div class="clm-mr-detail-section-title">Actions</div>
          <p style="font-size:13px; color:#666; margin-bottom:12px;">This request was returned. You can edit and resubmit it.</p>
          <div class="clm-mr-action-actions">
            <button class="clm-btn clm-btn-outline" ng-click="c.editRequest()">✏️ Edit & Resubmit</button>
          </div>
        </div>
       

</div>

        <div class="clm-mr-detail-section clm-mr-action-section" ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.state == 'Rejected'">
          <div class="clm-mr-detail-section-title">Actions</div>
          <p style="font-size:13px; color:#666; margin-bottom:12px;">This request was rejected. You can create a new request.</p>
          <div class="clm-mr-action-actions">
            <button class="clm-btn clm-btn-outline" ng-click="c.createNewRequest()">+ New Request</button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
 <div class="clm-ap-detail-section"
     ng-if="c.data.selectedRequest.aging_table && c.data.selectedRequest.aging_table.length > 0">
               <div class="clm-ap-detail-section-title">
    6-Month Aging Breakdown (Table)
  </div>

  <table class="clm-aging-table">
    <thead>
      <tr>
        <th>Month</th>
        <th>0-30</th>
        <th>31-45</th>
        <th>46-60</th>
        <th>61-75</th>
        <th>76-90</th>
        <th>91-120</th>
        <th>>120</th>
        <th>Total</th>
      </tr>
    </thead>

    <tbody>
      <tr ng-repeat="row in c.data.selectedRequest.aging_table">
        <td>{{row.month}}</td>
        <td>{{row.b0_30 | number}}</td>
        <td>{{row.b31_45 | number}}</td>
        <td>{{row.b46_60 | number}}</td>
        <td>{{row.b61_75 | number}}</td>
        <td>{{row.b76_90 | number}}</td>
        <td>{{row.b91_120 | number}}</td>
        <td>{{row.b120 | number}}</td>
        <td><b>{{row.total | number}}</b></td>
      </tr>
    </tbody>
  </table>

</div>]]></template></sp_widget></record_update>
